description.name: Entry
description.text: Fifteen single attacks (1.50 each), grants [Awoken Instructor], [Damage Cap +10000], [Switch Draw Mode (Water, Poison)] and [Lesson Time] to the user

description.name: Awoken Instructor
description.text: Water and Poison abilities don't consume uses and deal 5/10/15/20/30% more damage at ability rank 1/2/3/4/5, Water and Poison abilities trigger 1 additional time

description.name: Switch Draw Mode (Water, Poison)
description.text: Grants [Attach Water]/[Attach Poison] after using a Water/Poison ability

description.name: Attach Water
description.text: Replaces Attack command, increases Water damage dealt by 50/80/120% (abilities) or 80/100/120% (Soul Breaks), Water resistance +20%

description.name: Attach Poison
description.text: Replaces Attack command, increases Poison damage dealt by 50/80/120% (abilities) or 80/100/120% (Soul Breaks), Poison resistance +20%

description.name: Lesson Time
description.text: Grants [40% Damage Reduction Barrier 1] to all allies after using a Water or Poison ability

description.name: 40% Damage Reduction Barrier 1
description.text: Reduces damage taken by 40% for the next attack
